properties_to_be_validated.property_description: Verify that all assertions are satisfied in the program.
Verify that the relay is updated based on the value of GT1_OUT.

property.pattern_description: If 'instance.GT1_OUT = TRUE' is true at the end of the PLC cycle, then 'instance.relay = TRUE' should always be true at the end of the same cycle.

properties_to_be_validated.property_description: Verify that the temp_sensor does not overflow during the FOR loop.

property.pattern_description: 'instance.temp_sensor > 32767' is impossible at the end of the PLC cycle.

properties_to_be_validated.property_description: Verify that the error flag is not set to FALSE.

property.pattern_description: 'instance.error = FALSE' is impossible at the end of the PLC cycle.
